Every setting is in `config.toml`, which the recorder validates. Change them in the app's Settings, where the advanced ones are folded under each section, or with `spytify-cli set key=value`; `spytify-cli get` lists them.

### App

| Setting | Key | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Theme | `app.theme` | system, light, dark | `system` |
| Minimize to tray | `app.minimize_to_tray` | on, off | on |
| Start recording on launch | `app.autostart_recording` | on, off | off |
| Check for updates | `app.check_updates` | on, off | on |

### Output

| Setting | Key | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Output folder | `output.dir` | a folder: absolute, or starting with ~/ | `~/Music/Spytify` |
| Group by folders | `output.group_by` | none, artist, artist/album | `artist/album` |

Advanced:

| Setting | Key | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| File name prefix | `output.prefix` | none, counter, album_track | `none` |
| Add separators (_ instead of spaces) | `output.underscores` | on, off | off |
| File name template | `output.template` | placeholders {artist}, {title}, {album}, {track}, {year} | `{artist} - {title}` |
| Counter start value | `output.counter_start` | 0 to 999999999 | 1 |
| Counter digits | `output.counter_width` | 1 to 9 | 3 |
| Remove diacritics from file names | `output.ascii_filenames` | on, off | off |

### Encoding

| Setting | Key | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Output format | `encode.format` | mp3, aac, flac, wav | `flac` |
| Bitrate | `encode.bitrate_kbps` | 128, 160, 256, 320 | 160 |

Advanced:

| Setting | Key | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Embed album cover | `tags.cover` | on, off | on |
| Cover size | `tags.cover_size` | small, medium, large | `medium` |
| Replace track number with counter | `tags.track_from_counter` | on, off | off |
| Move parenthesised extra title to subtitle | `tags.extra_to_subtitle` | on, off | off |
| Multiple artists separator | `tags.artist_separator` | text | `, ` |

### Recording

| Setting | Key | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Minimum track length (seconds) | `recorder.min_seconds` | 0 to 3600 | 30 |
| Already recorded tracks | `recorder.duplicates` | skip, suffix, overwrite | `skip` |
| Skip to the next track when already recorded | `recorder.skip_duplicates_forward` | on, off | off |
| Record a single track then stop | `recorder.single_track` | on, off | off |
| Normalize volume | `recorder.normalize` | on, off | on |

Advanced:

| Setting | Key | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trim leading/trailing silence | `recorder.trim_silence` | on, off | on |
| Silence threshold (dBFS) | `recorder.silence_db` | -90 to -20 | -50 |
| Boundary search window (ms) | `recorder.boundary_window_ms` | 20 to 2000 | 300 |
| Stop the session after (0s = never) | `recorder.session_timer` | a duration such as 90m or 2h | `0s` |
| Target loudness (LUFS) | `recorder.target_lufs` | -30 to -5 | -14 |
| Pause player when disk is full | `recorder.pause_on_disk_full` | on, off | on |

### Ads

| Setting | Key | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mute ads | `recorder.mute_ads` | on, off | off |

Advanced:

| Setting | Key | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Treat items shorter than N seconds with no album as ads (0 = off) | `recorder.skip_short_untitled` | 0 to 600 | 60 |
| Record everything (podcasts, short untitled items) | `recorder.record_everything` | on, off | off |
| Mute the player on this computer while recording (macOS, Linux) | `player.mute_output` | on, off | off |

The recorded application is chosen with environment variables, not in `config.toml`: see [Command line](cli.html#configuration).
